summary: Iteration 14 — tested Doug LeMaire's 5 fixes: (1) map anchor at Maple Ridge/22374 Lougheed Hwy with gold-star office pin and Google Maps directions link, (2) strata/Form B/Depreciation Report content ban for detached/acreage/equestrian searches, (3) homepage sizing consistency across 1920/1366/375 viewports, (4) filters start empty on every session (no localStorage restore), (5) Home & Back buttons work in both DashboardBackHomeBar and classic BackHomeBar. Backend: 4/4 new strata-ban pytest cases pass (test_strata_content_ban.py). Frontend: all 5 items verified via Playwright. No critical issues found.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> nested in <option> (from x-source instrumentation), not functional; already noted in iteration_12/13.
Pre-existing DOM property warning: 'fetchpriority' should be 'fetchPriority'.

action_items: OPTIONAL: The review request referenced testids 'filter-panel' and 'filter-apply' — these do not exist. Actual testids are 'floating-filters' (container) and no dedicated testid on the Apply Filters button (uses role=button, name='Apply Filters'). Consider adding data-testid="filter-apply" to the Apply Filters button (DashboardMockup.jsx L627) for test stability.
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="filter-panel" alias to the floating-filters container for external consistency.
OPTIONAL: Fix pre-existing 'fetchpriority' React DOM warning and hydration warning <span> inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~13k lines — content-ban logic is well isolated in _search_glossary/_search_faqs, but the file itself remains oversized (violates 700-line guideline). Recommend continuing the doogie_sync.py extraction started in iteration_12/13.

DashboardMockup.jsx is >3900 lines — Home button/back/map/filter code sits alongside intent flow and testimonials. Splitting into smaller components (SearchLanding, ListingsMap, FiltersPanel) would improve maintainability.

Content-ban implementation correctly honours user-intent: 'strata rules for detached house' (user explicitly says strata) still returns strata content — proper exclude_content_patterns override verified.
